items.title: Fail-safe
items.author: DJ_Dave

items.title: from-scratch (session 2026-08-26)

items.title: MOVEMENT (germantechno3)

items.title: house

items.title: Squeaky Tinkering
items.author: Paul Gestwicki
items.license: CC BY-NC-NA (as written; not a real CC licence, probably meant CC BY-NC-ND or BY-NC-SA)
items.note: Short 909 groove from a university professor's song experiments. The licence tag is malformed, so ask the author before reusing it.

items.title: Ossuary
items.author: Stefanos Amanuel (ipkstef)
items.genre: UK bass: dark halftime drum & bass
items.note: 172 BPM halftime piece with a 32-bar arrangement; one of eight tagged liquid-DnB originals in the repo. Its chant sample is CC0 from Freesound, credited in the file.

items.title: Low Tide Radio

items.title: Deep Meditation (DnB)

items.title: footwork

items.title: jungle-gym

items.title: beatopia dub 250721

items.title: ambient 251003

items.title: ambient-experiment

items.title: Song Sanctuary theme

items.genre: world / hand percussion (shaker, clave, bongo) game score

items.title: Guarded Stones
items.author: Will Thompson (The Threadbare Authors)

items.title: Saudade Nº0
items.author: taconi

findings.claim: Strudel defines comment tags for authorship and licence: @by and @license with SPDX ids (e.g. CC-BY-SA-4.0), plus @genre.
findings.excerpt: Each license should be specified by using the correct identifier in the SPDX License List

findings.claim: Switch Angel is Jade Rose; WebExpo describes her as a Strudel maintainer.
findings.excerpt: When Switch Angel (Jade Rose) steps onto the main stage

findings.claim: Threadbare's first-party assets, including its Strudel scores, are CC BY-SA 4.0 and labelled per file with REUSE.
findings.excerpt: Threadbare's original assets are covered by Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0

findings.claim: taconi's per-file headers say CC BY-NC-SA even though the repo LICENSE is MIT, so file-level tags must be read, not just repo licences.
The pastagang site/code licence is an informal one-liner, not a recognised licence.
Switch Angel's pad and breaks sample packs are released under the Unlicense.
findings.excerpt: Some pad sounds I recorded (license: Unlicense)

findings.claim: fcm/my-strudel-repo licenses all patterns CC BY-SA 4.0 and says they are meant to be copied and played.
fjpolo/fjpolo-Strudel (MIT) has house, dubstep, acid and industrial files, but their headers credit Switch Angel Instagram reels, so they are derivatives, not originals.

gaps_remaining: boom bap / hip-hop: no licensed human original found; only an app's default beat and an unlicensed lo-fi sketch
techno: covered (2 licensed: DJ_Dave CC BY-NC-SA, fcm CC BY-SA)
house: no cleanly licensed original (kahlys has none; Gestwicki's tag is malformed)
UK garage / bass: no actual UKG/2-step piece; only DnB (ipkstef, CC BY-NC-SA). A UKG sample lead exists but has rights problems
footwork / juke: only one unlicensed sketch (ikesau); nothing licensed
reggae / dub: only one unlicensed piece (ed_crub); eefano's swampyreggae is in the known collection
ambient / drone: three unlicensed pieces; the only licensed one (lmorv, MIT) is derivative

Afro / Latin / world: the two Threadbare CC BY-SA percussion scores are game music, not Afro/Latin dance forms. No Afrobeat, amapiano, cumbia or samba originals; the (Algo|Afro) Futures performances are video only
IDM / glitch: three found but only Starnet is licensed (AGPL-3.0, an awkward fit for music reuse)
ambient generative: the pastagang corpus and taconi Fio (NC) only; no CC0/CC BY generative piece
notes: Method: gh repo and code search (setcpm/@license/@by/@genre plus --filename genre terms), the Codeberg API (the HTML explore page serves junk to scrapers), the uzu.lurk.org forum search (little yield), and Strudel docs and showcase sources. WebFetch hit a session limit, so pages were read with curl and the gh API. Every item URL's file was opened through the API or raw endpoints. Only headers were read, to get title, author, licence and genre; no code is reproduced here. Excluded: AI-generated corpora (A5TA/strudel-agents, imMatheus/daij, LeoYeAI, nukleas/cycletron), stock-tune copies (Bulka, godot-strudel, vscode forks), covers (achmad-miftahurrojak REDRED_CORTIS = CORTIS cover; Bulka gallery covers), and Switch-Angel-derived files (fjpolo). Licence pattern: explicit licences are rare, and most are NC (BY-NC-SA). Only fcm (CC BY-SA 4.0) and Threadbare (CC BY-SA 4.0) allow commercial reuse. Leads not followed up: WilliamOpenshaw generative repo, frenata/music compositions, jacksonchen666/random-strudel-bits (AGPL, pastagang shortcuts), the Strudel Discord.
